sermon.title: His Wings - April 23, 2023
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: The day is coming burning like an oven, but to those who fear His name the Sun of Righteousness rises with healing in His wings. Those who wait on the Lord—like Cornelius and the 120 at Pentecost—renew their strength. Don’t quench the Spirit; practice waiting on God together.
